name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the entire CopilotKit quickstart project: created the Next.js app, installed all three CopilotKit packages, set up the `.env` file, wrote the `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` runtime endpoint, wrapped the layout in `CopilotKit` provider, and added the `CopilotSidebar` to the page. TypeScript type-checking passed cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` returned exit code 0 with no errors). However, the `npm run build` command hung indefinitely on "Creating an optimized production build …" for over 10 minutes without progressing or emitting errors, so I could not verify that the app actually builds or that the copilot endpoint is reachable. The blocker appears to be a build-time hang, possibly related to the placeholder `OPENAI_API_KEY` or heavy dependency processing.

installed.evidence: added 777 packages, and audited 1140 packages in 2m

friction.detail: `Creating an optimized production build ...` never completes after 10+ minutes.
`No OPENAI_API_KEY found in env` leading to `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-placeholder`.
`npm warn deprecated lodash.get@4.4.2...` and `25 vulnerabilities (2 low, 10 moderate, 13 high)`.
`--no-turbopack` passed to `create-next-app` but build output shows `▲ Next.js 16.2.12 (Turbopack)`.
`Sign up for a free developer account on our Enterprise Intelligence Platform to get a license key. You'll use it later...`
